behavior.description: The behavior and its parameters. The type says which parameters there are.

oneOf.description: Apply the fault to the first few matching calls, then let the rest through.

n.description: How many matching requests the fault applies to before the rule lets the rest through

oneOf.title: first_n

oneOf.description: Apply the fault for a number of seconds from the first matching call, then recover.

sec.description: How many seconds the fault keeps applying, counted from the first call the rule matches

oneOf.title: for_duration

oneOf.description: Repeat a cycle of F (fault) and P (pass), one letter per matching call.

pattern.description: The cycle to repeat, one letter per matching request: F applies the fault, P lets it through

oneOf.title: pattern

oneOf.description: Apply the fault to a share of matching calls, chosen at random each time.

percent.description: What share of matching requests the fault applies to, as a percentage

oneOf.title: percent

fault.description: The fault and its parameters. The type says which parameters there are.

oneOf.description: Flip bits in the real response body, keeping its length, so whatever parses it meets a mangled payload. A response tier fault.

percent.description: How much of the body to mangle, as a percentage of its bytes

oneOf.title: corrupt

oneOf.description: Hold the call back before letting it through; the response is the real one, later. A connection tier fault.

jitter_ms.description: Random extra delay on top, up to this many milliseconds

ms.description: How long to hold the request back, in milliseconds

oneOf.title: delay

oneOf.description: Accept the connection and never answer, so the client waits until its own timeout fires. A connection tier fault.

max_ms.description: Give up and drop the connection after this long. Left out, the request hangs until the client does

oneOf.title: hang

oneOf.description: Set or strip response headers on an otherwise untouched response. A response tier fault.

remove.description: Response headers to strip, by name

set.description: Response headers to set, by name

oneOf.title: headers

oneOf.description: Answer 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header, to check that a client honours the hint. A response tier fault.

retry_after_sec.description: How many seconds the Retry-After header tells the client to wait

oneOf.title: rate_limit

oneOf.description: Turn the connection away, the way a host with nothing listening does. A connection tier fault.
oneOf.title: refuse

oneOf.description: Break the connection off, before anything is sent or part way through the real response. A connection tier fault.

after_bytes.description: Deliver this much of the real response before breaking the connection. Left out, nothing is sent at all

oneOf.title: reset

oneOf.description: Deliver a correct response slowly, trickling the body over the time given. A response tier fault.

ms.description: How long the whole body should take to arrive, in milliseconds

oneOf.title: slow_body

oneOf.description: Replace the upstream's response with a status code of your choosing; the upstream is still called. A response tier fault.

body.description: The body to answer with. Left out, the response has none

code.description: The status code to answer with instead of the upstream's

oneOf.title: status

oneOf.description: Deliver the real response at a crawl, capped at the bytes per second given. A connection tier fault.

bytes_per_sec.description: How fast the response is allowed to arrive, in bytes per second

oneOf.title: throttle

oneOf.description: Cut the response body off part way, leaving the real status and headers in place. A response tier fault.

after_bytes.description: Cut the body off after this many bytes

percent.description: Cut the body off after this share of it, as a percentage

oneOf.title: truncate

match.description: Which requests the rule applies to. Everything left out matches everything.

header.description: Header names and the values they must have.

host.description: A hostname like api.stripe.com, not a URL.

method.description: An HTTP method like GET or POST.

path.description: A path, with * standing in for the rest: /v1/charges/*.

port.description: The local port to listen on. Left out, Faultline assigns one from 9100 up.

upstream.description: The upstream, as an absolute URL: https://api.stripe.com.

enabled.description: Whether the rule applies. Rules written inside a scenario default to false.

id.description: How everything else names this rule.

name.description: What this rule is for, in a few words.
How the scenario is turned on and off.

rules.description: The rules this scenario turns on, named by id or written out in full.

oneOf.description: The id of a rule declared under rules.

description: The routes, bypass list, rules, and scenarios of one Faultline setup.

bypass.description: Hosts the forward proxy passes through untouched: no rules, no events, no interception.

items.description: A host (api.stripe.com), a host and port (localhost:9000), or a domain suffix (*.internal).

routes.description: Explicit routes: an upstream reachable on a local port, for clients that ignore proxy settings.

rules.description: Rules applied to matching traffic. A rule at the top level is on unless it says otherwise.

scenarios.description: Named situations: sets of rules that go on and off together.

title: Faultline configuration
